revisions.change_explanation: Initial chapter place: the attested island name with the cited modern identification recorded as a cited interpretation and a region-level approximate point.

content.summary: 阿兒奈波島, the island the biography records the first and second ships reaching on 天寶十二載十一月廿一日 (753), in the passage that places it south-west of 多禰島.

geometry.notes: An approximate, region-level placement at the island the cited reference work identifies with 阿兒奈波島. It is an identification, not a source statement of the eighth century, and no landing site is asserted.

modern_equivalents.note: The cited reference work identifies 阿兒奈波島 with 沖縄島; recorded as a scholarly identification.

content.editorial_notes: The island name is source-attested; the modern identification is a cited interpretation and is labelled as one. The island's own coordinate comes from Wikidata and is a modern reference point, not a historical location.

claims.statement: The biography names 阿兒奈波島 as the island the first and second ships reached on 天寶十二載十一月廿一日, south-west of 多禰島.

locator.value: 廿一日戊午，第一、第二兩舟同到阿兒奈波島，在多禰島西南

claims.statement: The cited reference work identifies 阿兒奈波島 with 沖縄島; the point is placed at that island's modern coordinate from Wikidata (CC0) as an approximate region-level placement.
claims.attributed_to: 琉球新報『沖縄大百科事典』「阿児奈波島」
